title: race_reset
description: Emitted when a new race starts: a track command, a track changed in game, or the game restarting the race

reason.description: Why the race started. track_change: a set_track or next_track, sent as the command arrives, before the new track loads, so the room still names the old track. room_track_change: the track was changed in game, sent right after the track_changed that reports it. room_sgso_start: the room's shared game state restarted. actor_<n>_rs_reset: a pilot's race state was reset. host_takeover (since 1.4.0): the room's host left and this game became the host; every pilot's run carries on, so laps flown before it are not reported again and lap numbers start again at 1.

is_host.description: Since 1.4.0. Always true when sent: a copy of the plugin in a room its game doesn't host writes this to its own race log with false and doesn't send it
